ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters constituting approximately <10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity distribution across the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white mottling and focal spots concentrated primarily on the distal tips and sporadically across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped convergence with an approximate visible angle of 70-80 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by water splash/turbulent flow pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high frequency and high amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) distributed continuously along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep originating from the midline and terminating in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white on dark background) visible on the distal ends of the left and right lobes, and scattered mid-lobe on the right side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and white pigmentation marks at the distal tips of both lobes; potential parasitic or barnacle attachment sites indicated by circular high-intensity pixel clusters.
